title: Weber 761001 22 1/2-Inch One-Touch Platinum Charcoal Grill, Black
description: 22-1/2 inch Platinum Grill is loaded with clever extras that turn classic Weber design into a grilling machine. We start with a heat- and weather-resistant thermoset plastic work table to make grill-side seasoning and preparation easy. The grill and table are set in a rugged heavy-gauge steel tube cart frame and adorned with three handy tool holders. To facilitate indirect cooking by heaping coals on either side of the grill grate, use the Charcoal Rails charcoal fuel holders for this 22-1/2-inch model. Then we added a convenient Tuck-Away Lid Holder to create a windshield for lighting the grill (and to hold the lid while you tend to the food), and tucked a wire storage rack below. Like its little sibling the One-Touch Gold Kettle, the One-Touch Platinum Grill boasts a stainless steel One-Touch Cleaning System; a hinged cooking grate for easy, safe, and quick addition of charcoal; and a high-capacity ash catcher. The result? A kettle so fancy we had to call it Platinum.

Weber's One-Touch Platinum kettle is a serious grill for serious cooks. Its sturdy, compact design makes great use of space. The cooking surface (22-1/2 inches in diameter) is big enough to accommodate six large steaks, twice as many burgers, or up to a dozen kebabs, and the grill's classic kettle shape keeps flare-ups to a minimum.

The grill's work surface, made of durable Thermoset plastic, provides a handy place to rest platters, cutting boards, and condiments; underneath, hanging hooks keep barbecue utensils right where you need 'em. Inside the grill, convenient movable baskets hold briquettes in tight clusters, allowing you to either focus or disperse the grill's heat to suit the cuisine. Weber's clever tuck-away design allows the lid to slide back out of the way when not in use, which also creates an effective wind barrier when lighting the grill. Once the grill is hot, the glass-reinforced, heat-resistant plastic handles stay cool.
To top it all off, Weber throws in a 31-page owner's guide filled with cooking tips and time-tested recipes for grilling everything from pork chops to bratwurst to Cornish hens.

title: Weber 2251001 Black Genesis Silver B Propane Gas Grill
description: When it's time to step up in grilling performance, the Genesis Silver B will keep the whole family satisfied. To fire up the party, the Crossover Ignition System lets you light all of the burners in succession with the push of one button. Then 36,000 Btus per hour course through three stainless steel burners that are individually adjustable for maximum temperature control. Porcelain-enameled Flavorizer Bars above the burners virtually eliminate flare-ups because cooking juices drip onto the bars and are turned to savory smoke. With the expansive porcelain-enameled cooking grates, you can grill an entire succulent turkey-so why not invite the in-laws? To help show off your grilling prowess, there's a handy warming rack for finished food, as well as a convenient Warm-Up Basket for rolls and bread. Three tool holders keep the essentials at your fingertips. The thermoset work surfaces resist heat and weather and are a breeze to clean. And don't worry about running out of gas mid-meal-the precise fuel gauge on the 20-pound tank tells you how much you have left. Locking casters and crackproof all-weather wheels keep you on the road to grilling success. Propane gas models come with a 20-pound propane tank. Limited lifetime warranty.

Weber's Genesis Silver B brings the convenience and precision of gas cooking to the great outdoors. This impressive system has enough cooking space for grilling gourmets to comfortably cook six large steaks, but the real value in this grill lies in its durability. The porcelain-coated steel lid is exceptionally strong and designed never to rust, fade, or peel. Three long-lasting stainless-steel burners--each with its own temperature control--cook countless meals evenly and efficiently. And the heat- and weather-resistant plastic work surfaces, handles, and wheels stand up to years of use.

Using this gas grill is easy. The push-button ignition system means you don't have to fuss with flints or matches. The grates and heat distributors are made from easy-to-clean porcelain-enameled steel and are designed to prevent flare-ups. The funneled bottom tray directs grease and cooking juices into a tidy, removable catch pan. And, if you're always wondering just how much propane is left in your tank, you'll love the accurate and easy-to-read fuel gauge that comes standard on this grill.

The barbecue pioneers at Weber know how to load up a grill with extras. The Silver B comes with a cooking box thermometer that doubles as a meat thermometer for more precise cooking needs. A rear warming rack and hanging basket are handy for keeping foods hot without overcooking. Utensil hooks and a sizeable exterior work area keep you organized as you spice, baste, poke, and turn your culinary creations. And a cookbook introduces you to an impressive array of grilling standards, from sizzlin' soul food to haute cuisine.
This grill comes partially assembled with clear step-by-step instructions. Even inexperienced grill mechanics can put it together in about an hour.

title: Weber 22 1/2-Inch Performer Charcoal Grill with Propane Gas Ignition, Black
description: Meet the ultimate charcoal grill: the Performer with Touch-N-Go Gas Ignition System. Now you can light those coals with the mere touch of a button from the 5-pound, propane fuel tank (included). The Char-Bin Storage container keeps 20 pounds of charcoal dry and at the ready. A hinged, triple-nickel-plated cooking grate makes it easy to add more fuel to the two welded steel Char-Basket Fuel Holders during longer cooking times. Beneath the handsome stainless steel work surface you'll find a rugged, robot-welded steel cart made of heavy-walled steel tubing sealed in weatherresistant polyurethane enamel coating. Is dinner ready yet? A dual-purpose thermometer monitors the cooking temperature inside the grill and doubles as a traditional quick-read meat probe to accurately check food doneness. Rugged wheels and locking casters make this grilling station easy to move when you're done cooking. Bravo. Available in 22-1/2-inch-diameter size only.

If you like cooking on charcoal but also want the quick-start convenience of a gas grill, Weber's Performer may be just what you're looking for. The gas ignition system--which cannot be used for gas grilling--lights your fire at the push of a button. The cooking surface (22-1/2 inches in diameter) is big enough to accommodate six large steaks, twice as many burgers, or up to a dozen kebabs, and the grill's classic kettle shape keeps flare-ups to a minimum. The grill is durable, too. The porcelain-coated steel bowl and lid are exceptionally strong and designed never to rust, fade, or peel. The grill's aluminum vents and ash catcher won't rust either, and the tripod base, nylon handles, and all-weather wheels--besides being exceptionally sturdy--make the grill remarkably easy to maneuver. Weber's patented One-Touch cleaning system--a clever setup of lever-activated blades--sifts ash out of the kettle and into a cooking-pot-shaped ash catcher. The Performer also includes a dual-purpose thermometer, which monitors the cooking temperature inside the grill and doubles as a traditional meat thermometer. A sizeable stainless-steel work surface conveniently covers a charcoal storage bin large enough to hold up to 20 pounds of charcoal.
